answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 35% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned and as a result nobody profits from it. Because the quill forfeiture is applied at exit, the lotus ledger totals each burn, and the prism audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 163 aliases thus destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
